summary: To add and sign an execution environment in private automation hub, Create execution environment under Automation Content > Execution Environments with a local Name, Upstream name, Registry and optional tags to include or exclude, then use the More Actions menu to Sync execution environment and Sign execution environment.
questions: How do I add and sign an execution environment in automation hub?
How do I include or exclude tags when adding an execution environment?
Where is the Sign execution environment option?

answer_card.title: Add and sign an execution environment
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Go to **Automation Content > Execution Environments** and click **Create execution environment**.
2. Set *Name* (local name), *Upstream name* (image on the remote server) and *Registry*.
3. Optional: tags to include (blank passes all tags) and tags to exclude.
4. Click **Create execution environment**.
5. From the More Actions menu, select **Sync execution environment**, then **Sign execution environment**.
